purpose: Expose ADV_Elite/JANUS swarm interesting events and anomalies in HRain through GitHub-backed canonical JSON without making HRain a write authority or embedding GitHub credentials in ESP32 firmware.
canonical_flow: trusted Registry Gateway authenticates/verifies and publishes to GitHub
GitHub becomes durable source of published JSON
HRain fetches indexes/records read-only and visualizes relationships
projection_rules: OBSERVED_REAL, DERIVED_FROM_REAL, PREDICTED and SIMULATED remain distinct
anomaly means detector event, not extraordinary physical truth
prediction links to later observation/score when available
github_pages_constraint: GitHub Pages is a static/read-only presentation surface and cannot be the authenticated ingest endpoint; the gateway performs writes while HRain consumes the resulting GitHub JSON.
